description.en: Every frontier image, video and audio model — open and closed source — in one AIGC creation platform inside DeepSeek Harness. A new account's credit is worth about 200 images, 3 short videos or 100 minutes of speech.
description.zh: 集结前沿的开源与闭源生图、生视频、音频模型，在 DeepSeek Harness 里完成 AIGC 创作。注册赠额约等于 200 张图、3 条短视频或 100 分钟语音。
